Commentary.Commentary: The chase is about to begin! The players concerned are out in the middle. Mohammad Naim and Soumya Sarkar are the Bangla openers. They combined for a century stand in the last match. How many runs will they add today? Tadiwanashe Marumani has the gloves on as Regis Chakabva is possibly unfit. Sikandar Raza to begin proceedings...

A target of 167 is still chasable on this pitch! Zimbabwe would feel that they are again 15-20 runs short. In the last game, the Bangla openers put the chase to bed very early, will we see a repeat telecast? With the series on the line, let's see how Zimbabwe turn up with the ball. Do join us in a short while.

Bangladesh's bowling was decent for most parts but they did bowl a few loose balls in between. Taskin Ahmed and Shakib Al Hasan bowled with good control while Shoriful Islam finished with a 3-wicket haul towards the end. But the tourists would be a bit disappointed to let Zimbabwe off the hook in the end overs.

A marked improvement in the batting of Zimbabwe and they have bettered their score from the last match. The Powerplay went well for them despite losing two wickets. Wesley Madhevere and Dion Myers got involved in a 57-run stand but it was a shade on the slower side. Wesley though batted with great intent in his knock, striking at 128.1. Towards the end, it appeared that the African team will once again lose their way but Ryan Burl came to their rescue with his 19-ball 34 and powered the hosts to 166. 54 runs came in the last 5 overs and Zimbabwe will be reasonably happy with their efforts with the bat this evening.

OUT! A wicket goes down on the final ball. Shoriful delivers a slower one, short in length around leg, Jongwe tries to heave it over the leg side but it takes the top edge and Shakib makes no mistake at deep mid-wicket. ZIMBABWE END ON 166/6!
Commentary.Howout: c Shakib Al Hasan b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: PUT DOWN! Short in length and around off, Burl gets across and pulls it over square leg. Sarkar in the deep goes down low but fails to take the catch. The batsmen cross for a run. Burl was ball-watching, otherwise, the second run was also on.
Mahmudullah is not happy with the replacement ball. The umpire though feels that it's good to go...
SIX! GIGANTIC! It has gone many a mile. That ball is not returning anytime soon. A length delivery outside off, Ryan shuffles across the stumps and plunders it over cow corner for a maximum.
A bouncer around leg, Burl ducks and lets it be. He is disappointed that it has not been given as a wide.
Short in length and on middle, Jongwe opens up for a pull shot over the leg side but only manages to drag it down to long on for a run. A good result for Zimbabwe as Burl returns on strike.
A great yorker, outside off, Ryan goes hard at it and gets it away off the toe end to square leg. The batsmen cross.
Wide! Shoriful bowls a slower one, full and way wide outside off, Burl swings and misses.
Too full and on middle, whipped to deep mid-wicket and Burl retained strike. 16 from the over.
SIX! This is nailed! Fuller in length and on middle, right in the slot for the batsman, Burl picks it up and dumps it into the stand at deep mid-wicket. What a great strike! 150 comes up!
Wide! Saifuddin loses his line completely. Sprays it way wide outside off, Burl lets it be.

A delivery around leg, Burl tries to heave but misses. It goes off his pads to point and they cross. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end, Saifuddin fails to collect and they take another. Two leg byes.
A terrific yorker on off, Jongwe keeps it out on the off side and hands the strike back to Burl.
Forces a full ball down to long on for a single.
FOUR! That's drilled! Fuller in length and outside off, great hand-eye coordination shown by Ryan as he bludgeons it through covers for a cracking boundary.
Full and outside off, Ryan pushes it gently to covers and keeps strike for the next over.
A bouncer on middle, Burl ducks underneath it at the last moment.
Luke Jongwe comes out to bat.

OUT! Big blow to Zimbabwe, Wesley is dismissed at this stage. Shoriful delivers a clever slower one, full and around leg, Wesley Madhevere clears his front leg for a big heave over the leg side but gets a top edge. Afif Hossain settles underneath it at long off and takes the skier safely. Well played, Wesley!
Commentary.Howout: c Afif Hossain b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Shoriful fires in a very full ball on middle, Burl tries to whip it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls to mid-wicket and they cross.
Short in length and wide outside off, Ryan shuffles across and then makes a leave.
Too full in length and wide outside off, Burl walks across the stumps and slogs it wide of long on for a couple of runs.
Wide! Off pace delivery but way wide outside off, Burl flashes and misses.
Slower one, wide outside off, it's sliced over the infield on the off side for a run.
A yorker on off, it's dug out from the inner half to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, Burl drives it through mid off and takes one.

A muted appeal for an lbw! A length delivery outside off, Wesley walks across the stumps with his attempted paddle sweep but fails to connect. It goes off his pads to square leg and they take a leg bye. The impact was an issue!
Misfield! Shortish and on middle, Ryan pushes it gently towards mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Shamim Hossain tries to attack the ball, fumbles and concedes an extra run.
FOUR! Smartly played! Mohammad Saifuddin bowls a full ball on the pads with fine leg up in the circle. All Burl has to do is to beat that fielder and he does so easily to fetch a boundary.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back into the attack. Just 12 runs from his first 2 overs.
Tucks it off his pads to square leg for a single. Shakib is done with his spell, 4-0-32-1.
Fullish and on middle, it's drilled down the ground for a single.
Ryan Burl is the new man in.
Ryan Burl is the new batsman.

OUT! Sikandar Raza is run out! A tossed up ball around off, Raza taps it down in front of point and calls for a run. Sarkar attacks the ball and fires in a throw at the bowler's end. Shakib is standing ahead of the stumps and he smartly lets it through his legs. It turns out to be a direct hit and Raza is found short in the replays. The third umpire flashes red for Sikandar.
Appeal for a run out, it's referred upstairs...
Fullish and outside off, Wesley drills it through covers and takes two. The throw from the deep is wayward at the bowler's end and they take another run.
SIX! Wesley is showing his class. Advances down the track to a full ball outside off and dismisses it over long off.
Quicker and flatter on middle, Raza moves back and plays it out to point for a run.
SIX! Short ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere smashes this one over the long on fence for a Biggie! Much needed for Zimbabwe.
Good length ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere lofts this towards long off for a couple of runs.
Mid off drops back. Third man comes up.
Back of a length ball, around off. Raza mistimes the heave towards mid off for one.
Clever bowling this from Taskin Ahmed. Saw Raza making room on the leg side. He pitched it full and outside off. Raza was not able to reach to the ball and he left it.
Back of a length ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere looks to pull it hard but gets the toe end of the bat and the ball rolls onto the leg side. The batsmen cross.
Slower full ball, on off. Sikandar Raza pushes it wide of mid off for one.
Taskin Ahmed is back on. 0/17 in his 3 overs so far.
A sharp bouncer, following the batsman down the leg side, Wesley Madhevere takes on the challenge to pull but misses. 7 runs and a wicket from the over.
Short in length and outside off, Raza plays the upper cut and it goes on one bounce to third man. Another single.
Fuller and on off, stroked firmly to extra cover where Mahmudullah made a half stop. They crossed. 100 up for Zimbabwe!
Sikandar Raza is the new batsman.

OUT! Myers is gone! The break in play probably hampered the momentum. Shoriful digs in a short delivery around off, angling away with extra bounce, Dion stands back and slaps it aerially towards the deep cover fielder. Not much timing and Mahedi takes it easily to break this stand that was bothering Bangladesh.
Commentary.Howout: c Mahedi Hasan b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: The umpires are not happy with the condition of the ball and they are changing it.
Slower one, full and on middle, it's forced down to long on for a single.

FOUR! Bang! Short in length and outside off, Wesley moves back to make room and cracks it wide of sweeper cover for a boundary. His third T20I fifty comes up with this shot. Can he give a big finish to the Zimbabwean innings?
Shoriful Islam is back on. 0/11 in his one over so far.
Yorker, outside off. It's dug out towards the cover fielder for a single by Wesley Madhevere.
Yorker again, on off. Wesley Madhevere digs it out to the bowler.
Good length ball, on off. Worked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball, outside off. Dion Myers looks to cut but misses.
Full ball, outside off. Driven towards long on for one.
WIDE! Way outside off. Wesley Madhevere leaves it.
Yorker on off. Dug out to the covers by Wesley Madhevere.
Shakib hits the yorker mark on off, Dion digs it out to the off side.
SIX! Shakib drags his length short and lands it on middle, Myers turns inside the crease and launches his pull over square leg for a maximum.
Darts it full and on off, driven to long off for a single.
Quicker ball on middle, defended back to the bowler.
Short and wide outside off, punched to covers.
DROPPED! Tossed up ball outside off, Wesley runs down the track and strikes it firmly to the off side. It's aerial but goes in and out of Mahmudullah's hands at covers.
Short and wide. Dion Myers looks to cut hard but misses.

Another mix-up! Good length ball, on off. It's played down to point. Wesley Madhevere wants a single but he's sent back. The point fielder throws it to the bowler at the non-striker's end. Taskin collects it and whips the bails off. They appeal, it's referred upstairs but the replays show that Myers has made it with a dive.
Short ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere pulls it towards long on for one, as the ball got big on him.

Big mix-up and a direct hit would have been curtains for Myers. Good length ball, on off. It's tapped towards point and Wesley wants a run. His partner is late in taking off but makes it safely as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. Taskin could have done better there, he should have tried to get behind the stumps quickly.
FOUR! Eased away! That's a gift on the pads and Myers tickles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Taskin Ahmed is back on. 2-0-11-0 are his figures so far.
Slower ball, outside off. Dion Myers misses the shot on the off side. He was deceived completely.

Shout for an lbw, not given. Flatter delivery, full and on middle and it's an arm ball. Wesley Madhevere tries to flick but misses. It deflects off his pads to covers. They appeal but probably it's missing leg. Zimbabwe are 77/2 at the halfway mark.
Arm ball, short and wide outside off, Myers cuts it through point for a single.
Quicker and fuller on middle, it's swept through square leg for one.
Loopy one this time, full and on off, Wesley Madhevere drives it to deep cover for a brace.
Aerial but safe! Flatter delivery on middle, skidding down, Myers tries to flick by going back but gets a leading edge. It flies towards covers but lands safely. They cross.
Senses the charge from the batsman and pulls his length back around off, Wesley forces it down to long on for a run.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on. 1/7 in his 1 over so far.
Short and wide. Wesley Madhevere cuts it hard. The ball falls just short of the backward point fielder. They take a single.
Low full toss, on the stumps. Driven towards long on for a single.
Short and wide. Punched towards cover for a single.

FOUR! Naim misfields. Good length ball, outside off, it's punched towards sweeper cover. Naim comes running in, takes his eyes off the ball as he tries to pick it up and misfields. It goes past him and meets the fence.
WIDE! Short ball, too high. Called a wide. Not a good idea to bowl that with the keeper up.
Full ball, outside off. Sliced towards sweeper cover for one.
Full ball, on off. Driven towards long off for one.
Quicker one, skidding in from middle, it's knocked down to long on for a single. The fielder in the deep fumbled slightly and the batsmen pinched another run.
Bowls it flat and short outside off, Wesley stays back and slaps it down to wide long off for one.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it down to long off for one.
Tossed up again, around off, driven to covers for a single.
Beaten! Tossed up ball close to off, Wesley Madhevere tries to reverse sweep but misses.
Too full in length and around off, eased down to long on for a couple.
Debutant Shamim Hossain is on with the ball.
Good length ball, outside off. Dion Myers looks to cut hard but mistimes it in front of the wicket.
Full and wide. Wesley Madhevere drives it towards sweeper cover for one.
Back of a length ball, around off. Gets big on Dion who pulls it towards long on. It goes on one bounce to the fielder for a single.
Back of a length ball, flicked off the back foot for a single.
Good length ball, on the pads. Flicked towards square leg for a run.
Good length ball, on off. Driven towards long on for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Misses the flick does Wesley Madhevere.
Soumya Sarkar is introduced into the attack.
FOUR! That's a delightful shot from Dion. He hurries down the track to a full ball and lofts it cleanly over covers for a boundary. 48/2 are Zimbabwe at the end of the Powerplay overs!
Flatter and around middle, it's eased through square leg for a single.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Too full and on middle, fired in, it's forced down to long on for a single.
Dion Myers is the new batsman.

OUT! Chakabva throws it away! Shakib delivers it flat and short around off, Regis wants to maximize the last Powerplay over and decides to attack Shakib. He attempts to hang back inside the crease and power it over the leg side but only manages a big top edge. It balloons in the air, Shoriful Islam is under it at extra cover, Soumya Sarkar is also present there, coming from mid off, but this time the catch has been taken. Shoriful smiles.
Commentary.Howout: c Shoriful Islam b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted ball, full and on off, Wesley knocks it down to long on for a run.
Shakib Al Hasan to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
FOUR! Good length ball, on the stumps. Regis Chakabva slogs this one wide of the deep square leg fielder for a boundary.
Full ball, on the stumps, driven towards long on for a single.
Overpitched ball on the stumps. Chakabva hits it straight down the ground, but it comes off the bottom half of the bat. They run one.
Good length ball, on the leg. Flicked towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball, pulled towards deep square leg for one.
Full ball, following the batsman down the leg side, Regis Chakabva shuffles back to make some room but yorks himself. The ball goes through to the keeper.
Mohammad Saifuddin to operate now.
Goes hard at a shortish ball outside off but only manages to play it back towards the bowler off the inside edge. 11 from the over!
FOUR! Shot! Fuller in length and on middle, Wesley brings down a straight bat and smashes it past the umpire at the other end for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on off, angling away, too close to cut, Madhevere pushes at it and gets it away off the bottom edge. The keeper collects it to his right.
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Wesley tries to pull but misses.
Forces a length ball to mid on and rushes across to the other end. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.

SIX! Goodness me, that's a huge hit from the bat of Chakabva. Fuller length ball around off, angling away, Regis clears his front leg and smokes it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Once again the bowler from this end has been greeted with a six.
Shoriful Islam is into the attack now.
Short and wide. Wesley Madhevere looks to pull it hard but misses. The ball goes through to the keeper.
Full ball, outside off. Driven towards the cover fielder.
WIDE! Down the leg side.
FOUR! Short ball and Wesley Madhevere pulls it cleanly towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. WOW, that made a cracking sound.

BIG MISS! That has gone in the air, no communication between the fielders and it drops safely in between. You got to call for it guys. Short in length and on middle, Wesley top edges his attempted pull shot towards deep backward short leg. Shoriful runs back from short fine leg, Mahedi is running across to his right from deep mid-wicket, no calling whatsoever and in the end, both leave the catch for each other. The batsmen take a run. Now the complaining begins with both the fielders blaming each other.
Length ball, on the pads. Whipped towards deep square leg for one.
Good length ball, around off. Wesley Madhevere looks to drive on the up, gets an outside edge which falls just short of the backward point fielder.
Flatter and off, Regis defends it back to the bowler. A good finish to the over by Mahedi.
The in-form Regis Chakabva walks in next.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Mahedi pulls his length back slightly and serves it close to off, Marumani decides to go back and punch it through the line as he thought the ball will spin away. But to his surprise, it skids on with the angle, beats his bat and goes on to shatter the stumps. A good comeback from the bowler.
Tossed up ball landing full on off, Tadiwanashe Marumani gets on the front foot and defends it back.
Mahedi comes from 'round the wicket and bowls a full ball around leg, it's worked to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Bang! Mahedi goes flat and full wide outside off, Wesley attacks the width and slaps it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
SIX! What a way to welcome the offie! Full and flighted around off, Wesley Madhevere leans into the shot and lofts it nonchalantly over long off for a maximum.
Mahedi Hasan to operate from the other end.
Short ball, around off stump, the batsman ducks under it again.
Short ball, on leg stump. Tadiwanashe Marumani ducks under it.
Good length ball, outside off. Guided towards third man by Wesley Madhevere for a single.
Good length ball, around off. Tapped towards backward point.
BEATEN! Played the wrong line did Wesley Madhevere. Good length ball, outside off. Looks to drive, but misses.
Full ball, on the pads. Flicked towards deep square leg for three runs. Good fielding in the deep to save a run.
The players are on the field! Tadiwanashe Marumani and Wesley Madhevere are the openers for Zimbabwe. Taskin Ahmed to begin proceedings. Here we go...
Players observe a minute's silence to show their respect as Aminul Islam Biplob lost his father last night. Condolences to the family.

Mahmudullah, the skipper of Bangladesh, says that they would have chased anyway as it's a good surface. Wants to restrict Zimbabwe to a low score. Mentions that the bowling in the Powerplay is something they want to improve.

Sikandar Raza, the captain of Zimbabwe, says that the pitch looks good for batting and in the last game, they didn't execute their plans with the bat. Tells that it was not a 155 surface in the last match and they want to do better.

Pitch report - The surface looks flat and dry, and will be very good for batting. The same strip was used for the third ODI where both teams scored big. The ball will nicely come onto the bat. Expect a lot of fireworks!

Regis Chakabva is down for a chat. He says he is feeling good, but wants to convert those starts into a big wcore for the team. As a Senior player of the team, he should take more responsibility and take the team forward. He feels they failed to capitalize with the start they had got in the previous game, and are looking forward to correct those mistakes in the upcoming matches.

Regis Chakabva is up for a chat! Says that he is feeling alright and is just trying to enjoy his cricket. Tells that, fortunately, he has been scoring some runs of late. Adds that it's his responsibility as he is the senior guy in the side. Mentions that they need to convert those little moments and the plan will be to try and have as many wickets for the backend.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Mohammad Naim, Soumya Sarkar, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah (C), Nurul Hasan (WK), Afif Hossain, Shamim Hossain (On debut, in for Liton Das), Mahedi Hasan, Mohammad Saifuddin, Taskin Ahmed (In for Mustafizur Rahman), Shoriful Islam.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Tadiwanashe Marumani, Wesley Madhevere, Regis Chakabva (WK), Dion Myers, Sikandar Raza (C), Milton Shumba (In for Tarisai Musakanda), Ryan Burl, Luke Jongwe, Wellington Masakadza, Blessing Muzarabani, Tendai Chatara (In for Richard Ngarava).
It's toss time in Harare. Mahmudullah and Sikandar Raza are out in the middle. The latter flips the coin, the Bangla skipper again calls it incorrectly and ZIMBABWE WILL BAT FIRST!

It's a quick turnaround for the teams and we are here for the second T20I. Hello and welcome everyone to the coverage and we are excited to have your company. Bangladesh handed yet another thrashing to Zimbabwe on this tour to take a lead in the T20I series and would be looking to close it today itself. The hosts though would try to throw a spanner in Bangladesh's plans. They did show sparks with the bat in the last outing and if the batting comes good for 20 overs, we can certainly expect entertainment.
